name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-daisy
title: Super Mario World Styled Daisy
description:
Here's Daisy in the Style of Super Mario World. Say hi to her!
There's 3 types of GFX32:
- The first is the Normal Cape from Super Mario World.
- The Second is a stylized version of the first (to match with this Peach).
- The Third one is the Raccoon version (use with this Patch).
Well, most of the Frames were an edit from the Peach above, but even so, I hope you like it!
Give Credit to LinkstormZ.
Requested by Paithus.
